name: Bones of the Error
summary:
Nothing feels quite the same as it used to, yet it all still follows the same familiar beats. BB tags along with her sister ZZ to a convention far outside the strange town she's used to, but it seems that something follows her no matter where she goes in this changed world. Will she be able to ignore it, or will this feeling drag her six feet under?

10th game in the "of the error" cartoon horror series. Arrows or WASD to walk around, Enter to confirm.

Just kidding! Bones of the Error is a fake installment in the just-as-fake game series, Anthology of the Error. The game was made for SiIvagunner's April Fools' Day 2026 event and is meant to be a combination of Anthology of the Killer and the Undertale AU, Errortale
